request.style: English, female solo voice, warm and intimate, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft drums, hopeful and reflective, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I tore down the walls I built myself
The law said I was dead and still
I died to the rules that bind my soul
So I could live for God with no control

[Pre-Chorus]
I have been crucified with Christ
My old self is gone in the mist

[Chorus]
It is no longer I who live
But Christ who lives in me
The life I live in the flesh
Is faith in the Son of grace
He loved me and gave himself
For me and for my rest

[Verse]
I do not set aside His grace
If law made me right, it was in vain
Christ did not die for nothing at all
My hope is found in His embrace

[Pre-Chorus]
I have been crucified with Christ
My old self is gone in the mist

[Chorus]
It is no longer I who live
But Christ who lives in me
The life I live in the flesh
Is faith in the Son of grace
He loved me and gave himself
For me and for my rest

[Bridge]
Who loved me and gave himself
For me and for my rest
Faith in the Son of God
Is where my life is best

[Chorus]
It is no longer I who live
But Christ who lives in me
The life I live in the flesh
Is faith in the Son of grace
He loved me and gave himself
For me and for my rest

[Outro]
Christ who lives in me
Faith in His grace
